name: Archivo Nacional Completo de Sorteos
objective: Preserve every recoverable official draw for every covered Spanish state lottery game, from the earliest verifiable record through the present, and append every future draw after official publication.
principles: Official SELAE evidence is the primary source.
Never silently invent or interpolate a missing draw.
Historical gaps remain explicitly marked until verified.
Raw source evidence and normalized records are preserved separately.
Corrections are append-only and auditable; previous values are never silently overwritten.
Each record carries game, draw identifier, date, result payload, source URL, retrieval timestamp, verification state and checksum.
Christmas, El Nino and ordinary Loteria Nacional remain distinct analytical datasets.
Rule changes create model eras so historical draws are interpreted under the rules valid at that time.

layers.purpose: records passing schema, range, uniqueness and source checks
derived statistics; always rebuildable from validated data

futureUpdatePolicy: After an official result is published, ingest, validate, checksum, append, refresh completeness metrics, then recompute dependent features and shadow-ledger evaluations.
analyticsRule: Models may train only on VALIDATED records and backtests must be chronological/walk-forward.
